system.description:
A freelance mounted warrior fighting for coin, not a sworn order.

  • Cavalry Strike: Advantage on your first melee attack roll each round while mounted. Mount gains advantage vs fear while ridden.
  • Soldier's Rep: Advantage on Persuasion when negotiating pay or contracts. Reputation among mercenary companies and caravan guilds.
